research.title: Getting Cited by ChatGPT and Claude: A GEO Playbook for Technical Content
research.originalTitle: Your Blog Lost 58% of Its Clicks. Here's the GEO Playbook That Actually Works.
research.titleNote: Reformulated per user request 2026-08-19 — original was clickbait-framed and addressed bloggers rather than the engineering audience. New title targets the real query intent.
research.whyTrending: Ahrefs measured a 58% CTR reduction on the #1 result for AI Overview keywords in Feb 2026; small publishers are down ~60% over two years and Google referrals to publishers fell 38% YoY. Meanwhile LLM-referred visitors convert at 15.9% (ChatGPT) and 10.5% (Perplexity) vs ~1.76% for organic. Every GEO post out there is marketing fluff — nobody has written the engineer's version: llms.txt, structured data, chunk-level answerability, citation tracking, and what actually gets a technical post quoted by Claude and ChatGPT. Directly self-relevant and highly shareable.
research.gapNote: Zero coverage on the blog. High volume, evergreen, and the post is its own proof-of-concept.
